messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "swallow the capsule or tablet whole to avoid exposure to a potentially fatal overdose"
set: ["swallow the capsule or tablet whole to avoid exposure to a potentially fatal overdose", "swallow the extended-release capsule or tablet whole", "swallow capsule whole", "swallow delayed-release capsule whole", "cannot swallow tablet whole", "do not swallow tablet whole", "swallow the regular tablet whole with a glass of water", "crush tablet if cannot swallow whole", "swallow the extended-release capsule or tablet whole and do not crush, chew, or break it", "if you cannot swallow a capsule whole open it", "swallow the whole or half tablet without crushing or chewing it", "swallow it whole", "confusing the two units can cause a fatal overdose", "tell doctor if child cannot swallow capsule whole", "swallow extended-release capsule whole and do not crush or chew", "do not swallow the strip whole"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
